svg.title: True Worship
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 6 panels. Two columns side by side: Refused and Received, row for row. Panel 1 (Acts 10:25-26): Peter lifting up Cornelius, a centurion, who has fallen at his feet. Caption: "Cornelius falls at his feet. Peter refuses it." Peter says: "Stand up; I too am a man." Panel 2 (Matthew 14:33): in the boat after the storm, the disciples kneel before Jesus. Caption: "Jesus accepts it." The disciples says: "Truly you are the Son of God." Panel 3 (Revelation 22:8-9): John kneeling, a voice of light speaking from above him. Caption: "An angel refuses it." The angel says: "You must not do that! I am a fellow servant with you." The angel says: "Worship God." Note: "The angel is drawn as a voice." Panel 4 (Matthew 28:9): the open tomb behind; the risen Jesus greets Mary Magdalene and the other Mary, who kneel at His feet. Caption: "They took hold of His feet and worshiped Him." Jesus says: "Greetings!" Panel 5 (Revelation 13:4, 15): a crowd bowing low before a stone image under a dark sky. Caption: "At the end, the beast demands it, and those who refuse are put to death." The world says: "Who is like the beast, and who can fight against it?" Note: "The beast is not drawn. Its image is (Revelation 13:14-15)." Panel 6 (Revelation 5:13-14): a throne of light; elders in white kneel before it with their crowns laid down, and a great crowd kneels behind them. Caption: "Every creature in heaven and on earth worships the One on the throne and the Lamb." Every creature says: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever!" The point: Worship belongs to God alone. Angels and apostles refuse it, the beast demands it, and Jesus receives it because He is God. So bow before the Father and the Lamb with your whole life (John 4:23; Revelation 5:13).

text.tspan: To him who sits on the throne

svg.text: Worship belongs to God alone. Angels and apostles refuse it, the beast
demands it, and Jesus receives it because He is God. So bow before the
Father and the Lamb with your whole life (John 4:23; Revelation 5:13).
The angel and the One on the throne are drawn as a voice and as light; the beast is not drawn.
